title: The Healer's Hut
text: A hedge-healer's hut, all herbs and smoke, and the healer at the door with her arms folded. She nursed one of your Lost for a week before they slipped away in the night without a word. She kept their bandages, and their bandages are not the right colour.

options.label: The best healer asks what wounds she tended.

outcomes.text: She tells, healer to healer, and gives you her salves for them, and points the way they went.
She takes the coin, and blesses the House, and does not mention the bandages again.

options.label: Accuse her of selling them out.

outcomes.text: She did not. She tells you nothing now, and shuts the door.
